evals.prompt: Here is the Functional Specification Document for a User Management System. Please analyze it and generate the complete technical artifacts including spec_api.md, erd.md (with a DBML block for dbdiagram.io), and task.md.
evals.expected_output: Markdown artifacts: spec_api.md with endpoints and flow logic; erd.md with tables/columns/indexes plus a ```dbml``` block; task.md with dev task cards and acceptance criteria. Formats should align with references/spec_api_format.md, references/erd_format.md, references/task_format.md.

evals.prompt: I need technical specifications from this FSD. Generate the API spec, ERD, and developer tasks.
evals.expected_output: Comprehensive spec_api, erd, and task markdown grounded in the FSD; consistent naming across artifacts.

evals.prompt: Compare this new FSD with our existing ERD and API spec. Produce a Gap Report.
evals.expected_output: Structured Gap Report per references/gap_analysis.md: database changes table, missing endpoints, recommendations. Uses tagged existing files when provided.

evals.prompt: Check consistency between the ERD, API spec, and task cards. List errors and warnings.
evals.expected_output: Consistency Report per references/consistency_check.md with severity columns and fix suggestions.

evals.prompt: We are still discussing scope with the BA. List open questions only — do not write full spec yet.
evals.expected_output: QUESTION_FOR_BA / ambiguity list; no premature full spec_api unless user asks to assume.

scripts_smoke.description: Validate sample spec if path provided
scripts_smoke.note: sample_fsd is FSD not spec — expect WARNs; use a real spec_api.md for green OK
